verdict.rationale: The Private Equity page says the firm advises funds (including technology-sector funds), companies and investors on deal documentation and exits. The Funds page covers venture capital firms' formation and capital deployment. Together these give only adjacent, thin support for a venture financing practice, and there is no dedicated page for priced equity rounds. missing for 10: an explicit venture financing practice description, stated coverage of seed through late-stage priced rounds, stated deal volume, named representative transactions, independent corroboration
